name: FND_SAVED_SEARCH_B
description: The primary table for storing Saved Searches.

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_ID
columns.description: SAVED_SEARCH_ID - Unique internal id for primary key.

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_CODE
columns.description: SAVED_SEARCH_CODE - A Unique code for the saved searches.

columns.name: SEARCH_TYPE
columns.description: SEARCH_TYPE: The type of saved search.  Values 'SAVED' and 'RECENT'.

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: VERSION - Semantic version of the saved search object.

columns.name: CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description:
CONTEXT_CODE - A striping attribute that keeps one set of saved searches distinct from another.

Example: 'CRM', 'HCM'

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: OBJECT_TYPE - a sub classification of CONTEXT_CODE for striping saved searches.

columns.name: APPLIED_TYPE
columns.description:
APPLIED_TYPE - The level the saved search will be applied to - one of:
USER - a USER Saved Search.  The username will be in the APPLIED_NAME field.
ROLE - a Saved search for users with a given Role.  The role will be in he APPLIED_NAME field.
SYSTEM - a system saved search, all users will see it.  The APPLIED_NAME field will contain 'SYSTEM'.

columns.name: APPLIED_NAME
columns.description: APPLIED_NAME - Who saved search be applied to - dependent on the APPLIED_TYPE.

columns.name: OWNER_TYPE
columns.description:
OWNER_TYPE - The owner type of the saved search - one of:
USER - a USER Saved Search.  The username will be in the OWNER_NAME field.
ROLE - a Saved search for users with a given Role.  The role will be in he OWNER_NAME field.
SYSTEM - a system saved search, all users will see it.  The OWNER_NAME field will contain 'SYSTEM'.

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: OWNER_NAME - dependent on the OWNER_TYPE.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: ENABLED_FLAG - Is this saved search enabled (Y/N).

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: DEFAULT_FLAG - Is this the default Saved Search?  The USER saved search will be run in preference to a default ROLE or SYSTEM saved search.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: VISIBLE_FLAG - Is the Saved Search shown in UI to users?

columns.name: AUTO_RUN_FLAG
columns.description: AUTO_RUN_FLAG - Is the Saved Search automatically executed?  Some saved searches should not be run blind and require users to provide keywords before execution.

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH
columns.description: SAVED_SEARCH - A CLOB of data representing the saved search.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_DATA
columns.description: USER_DATA - Provides optional ability to store additional user data about the saved search.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Seed data file from which the row originates.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
